result: Done. ## What was created **`src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/StringEscapeUtilsAgentTest.java`** — 76 test methods, JUnit 3.8.1 style (`extends TestCase`, `suite()` + `(String name)` ctor, `assertEquals`-based) matching the other tests in the project (e.g. `CharEncodingTest`, `EntitiesTest`, `StringUtilsTest`). Source is strict ASCII (non-ASCII/control chars built via a `chr(int)` helper) because the project's `` sets no encoding. ## Coverage (public API only) | Method(s) | What's tested | |---|---| | `escapeJava` / `escapeJavaScript` (String + Writer) | control chars, `"`/`\`/`/` escaping, single-quote difference between the two, `\uXXXX` with upper-case hex, boundaries 0x0F/0x10/0x1F/0x20/**0x7F pass-through**/0x80/0xFF/0x100/0xFFF/0x1000, ``→`<\/a>` (the Lang-52 fix), null→null, `""`→`""`, null-Writer→`IllegalArgumentException`, null-string→empty Writer | | `unescapeJava` / `unescapeJavaScript` (String + Writer) | control/quote/slash unescapes, `\uXXXX` (upper & lower hex), unknown `\x`→`x`, dangling trailing `\`, **truncated `\u` escape dropped**, invalid hex → `NestableRuntimeException`, round-trip vs `escapeJava` | | `escapeHtml` / `unescapeHtml` (String + Writer) | `<>&"` entities, apostrophe *not* escaped, named high-unicode (`© é   € ≤`), unnamed→`&#decimal;`, numeric `&#d;`/`@`/`@`, unknown entity & missing `;` left verbatim, `𐀀` overflow left verbatim, round-trip | | `escapeXml` / `unescapeXml` (String + Writer) | 5 basic entities, `'`→`'` (unlike HTML), non-ASCII→`&#decimal;`, `©` *not* resolved by XML, round-trip | | `escapeSql` | single-quote doubling, `"`/`%`/`_` untouched, null/empty | | constructor | public, class public & non-final | ## Verification ``` defects4j compile → OK (compile + compile.tests) JUnitCore org.apache.commons.lang.StringEscapeUtilsAgentTest → OK (76 tests) ``` Only `StringEscapeUtilsAgentTest.java` was added; no other file was touched (the pre-existing `StringEscapeUtilsTest.java` stub is unchanged).
